source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with layered ink-and-color mountains, misty valleys, pine groves, cliffside buildings, streams, bridges, and foreground rocks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_monumental_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large central mountain mass rising in the upper half, with rounded layered ridges, steep gullies, and dense texture strokes. Include the full clustered summit and descending central slopes, but exclude the red seal above, distant side peaks, and lower village areas.
must_preserve: arched contour linework defining stacked ridges
dry-brush cun texture and short dark ink strokes
soft ochre-green washes on rock faces
mist-softened lower edges where slopes fade into the valley
dark dotted vegetation accents along ridge crests

motifs.name: right_distant_misty_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountain chain on the upper right, including the pointed triangular peak and lower receding ridges emerging from mist. Avoid the nearer right cliff and village below.
must_preserve: faint ink outlines softened by atmospheric wash
triangular peak geometry
low layered ridgelines receding to the right
misty blank spaces between peaks
subtle ochre-gray tonal transitions

motifs.name: mid_right_cliffside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small village cluster built into the middle-right cliff terraces, with several tiled roofs, retaining ledges, and rocky slopes around the structures. Exclude distant peaks above and foreground pine masses below.
must_preserve: thin roof outlines and layered eaves
small rectangular building walls
terraced cliff ledges under the buildings
dark stippled shrubs along paths and ridges
vertical rock texture strokes descending the cliff

motifs.name: mid_left_pine_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the pavilion group nestled among tall pines in the mid-left lower valley. Include the stacked roofs, surrounding pine trunks, and nearby rocks, but avoid the calligraphy at the far left and unrelated lower cascade.
must_preserve: tiered roof geometry with fine ink eave lines
slender vertical pine trunks
dense needle clusters around the buildings
rock outlines and shaded bases
soft green and ochre wash around the grove

motifs.name: rocky_cascade_pool
motifs.description: Isolate the small rocky cascade and pool area in the lower-left middle, where water flows between rounded stones with a few green shrubs nearby. Do not include the left-side inscription or the large foreground pavilion below.
must_preserve: broken ink lines indicating flowing water
rounded boulder outlines with textured shading
small dark pebble clusters in the stream
bright green shrub accents near the banks
soft wash transitions around the pool

motifs.name: foreground_central_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central foreground grove of mature pines growing over rocks and slopes. Include interlacing trunks, umbrella-like needle clusters, and rocky bases, but avoid the waterfront buildings at lower left and the right streambank trees.
must_preserve: fine radiating pine-needle linework
twisting trunks and branching structure
dark ink clusters inside foliage masses
ochre-gray rock texture under the trees
small green color accents on nearby shrubs

motifs.name: right_cliff_pines_bamboo_and_hut
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground cliff vegetation group: tall pines, bamboo-like leafy stems, a small simple hut or pavilion tucked among trunks, and the rocky slope beside the pale stream. Exclude the central pine grove to the left as much as possible.
must_preserve: delicate pine needle clusters on tall trunks
bamboo leaf sprays in green wash
small hut roof and wall lines hidden among trees
vertical rock and cliff texture strokes
pale negative-space water edge beside the bank

motifs.name: lower_left_waterfront_pavilion_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left waterside architectural complex with pavilion roofs, raised walkways, bridge railings, posts, and adjacent rocks at the water’s edge. Exclude the calligraphy and red seal on the left margin.
must_preserve: long horizontal bridge deck with repeated vertical rail posts
dark tiled roof outlines and projecting eaves
thin support pilings beneath the walkway
rounded shoreline rocks with ink shading
pale water wash around the structure

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
